newsitem.title: UK: UK housing starts rise 18 pct in 3 mths to October.
newsitem.headline: UK housing starts rise 18 pct in 3 mths to October.

text.p: UK housing starts rose 18 percent on a seasonally adjusted basis in the three months to October from the previous three months while total completions were up one percent, the Department of Environment said.
In the latest three months, a total of 48,000 dwellings were started, up 20 percent on the same three months a year ago. Completions totalled 44,400 and were down five percent from a year ago.
Private enterprise housing starts were up 18 percent in the three months to October from the previous three months, while completions were unchanged.
Housing association starts and completions of new dwellings in the three months to October were up compared with the previous three months.
Both starts and completions by local authorities and government departments remained at a low level, the DOE said.
